name: Bronte Hughes
bio:
Bronte Hughes practically grew up in the pits. Her father was a race engineer for a touring car team, and she spent weekends immersed in the roar of engines and the smell of burning rubber. Initially drawn to the technical side, she excelled in mechanical engineering, earning top marks at university. After a brief stint designing components for a V8 Supercar team, Bronte transitioned into management, realizing her true strength lay in coordinating talent and resources to achieve peak performance.

Her pragmatic approach is her hallmark. Bronte prioritizes data-driven decisions and clear communication, fostering a culture of accountability within the team. She's known for her ability to remain calm under pressure, a vital asset in the high-stakes world of motorsport. Bronte's not afraid to make tough calls, but she always backs her team and empowers them to take ownership of their work. She aims to bring Haas into the midfield and then challenge for podiums.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, slightly wavy, usually tied back in a practical ponytail.
physical.description: Bronte has a determined look with sharp cheekbones and a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen to jot down observations.
Has a habit of tapping her fingers on the table when deep in thought.
Insists on a pre-race team huddle with a specific, motivational quote.
